source.text: እስመ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ *ኢአመነ፡ ወኢሰባሕነ፡ ለስሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ [ወኢሰባሕናሁ፡ ለእግዚእነ፡] ወተስፋነ፡ ኮነ፡ ዲበ፡ በትረ፡ መንግሥት*ነ፡ ወዲበ፡ ስብሐቲነ።
source.note: Charles1906 printed116/PDF154, exact63:7. This source-only title spelling correction preserves the earlier accepted unit and English/notes unchanged except for the one printed word; broader chapter63 remains held.

translation.text: For before him we did not believe, and we did not praise the name of the Lord of Spirits, [and we did not praise our Lord,][a] and our hope was in the scepter[b] of our kingdom and in our glory.

footnotes.text: Charles identifies this bracketed clause as dittography in printed p.116 note 5. It is retained in brackets here rather than presented as an uncontested part of the text.
Scepter can also be rendered staff or rod; the royal image is retained.
